chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who said:

Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And let them go round the Ancient House.' He said: 'The obligatory circumambulation is the circumambulation of the women.'

key_terms.طَوَافُ النِّسَاءِ: The circumambulation of the women (a specific ritual)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Tawaf Al-Nisaa in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) clarifies that the phrase 'let them go round the Ancient House' in Surah Al-Hajj specifically refers to the obligatory circumambulation performed by women, known as *Tawaf Al-Nisaa*. This interpretation highlights the distinct ritual status of women in Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing their mandatory *Tawaf* from the broader communal or male-specific obligations often discussed in other schools of thought.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad who said, ‘Abu Al-Hassanasws said regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [22:29] and let them go round the Ancient House. Heasws said: ‘The Obligatory Tawaaf, the Tawaaf Al-Nisaa’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad who has said the following:

“This is about the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘They must perform Tawaf around the free House. ’[22:29] Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the obligatory Tawaf is Tawaf of al-NisaY”
